Fusiform_Pelagic_Chassis.description: A perfectly streamlined, torpedo-shaped body plan tapering at both ends to utterly minimize hydrodynamic drag. The muscular arrangement is primarily myomeres, allowing for explosive bursts of aquatic speed but rendering terrestrial movement impossible.

Dorsoventrally_Flattened_Core.description: An extremely flattened, pancake-like skeletal structure perfectly adapted for life on the sea floor. It allows the entity to completely bury itself beneath a thin layer of sand and ambush unsuspecting prey from below.
